title: Developer futures to 2031 — recursive taxonomy draft
researchStage: Initial scaffolding for continuing >=24-hour research; not final synthesis

interpretation.personalFit: Unknown until skill evidence and constraints are verified
interpretation.knowledgeVersusMarket: Stable concepts organise learning. Opportunity, timing and job-market implications remain hypotheses requiring separate evidence.
interpretation.projectStatus: Every project / metric is proposed, not executed. Gates are portfolio hypotheses, not industry safety standards.
interpretation.sourceStatus: Evidence refs point to saved primary-source research notes. Taxonomy creation did not independently verify every linked claim.
interpretation.permissions: This file authorises no installs, purchases, outreach, private-data access, external actions or physical operation.
